editorial:
You follow a tiny, determined sperm as he and millions of rivals race through a wild, cartoon version of a teenage boy's body. The teen is nervous about his first time, and every heartbeat, snack, and awkward thought turns the journey into a crazy obstacle course. The sperm has a big personality, his friends are goofy, and the egg feels like a distant prize. The whole thing plays like a fast, silly adventure with bright colors and nonstop jokes, so you never feel bored even when the humor gets a little gross.

The animation is lively, the voice acting keeps the characters fun, and the pacing rarely slows down. Some jokes land better than others, and the body humor can be a bit much if you are sensitive, but the heart underneath keeps it from feeling mean. If you enjoy outrageous adult animation and do not mind crude humor, this is a great pick for a late-night watch with friends.
endingExplained: In the final stretch, your favorite sperm beats all the rival swimmers and finally reaches the egg, ready to claim victory. The twist is that the teenager's big moment gets interrupted by an embarrassing real-world mishap, so fertilization never happens. Instead, the egg stays untouched, and the sperm's epic journey becomes a very funny what-if story about almost becoming a person.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves outrageous adult animation and crude comedy.
